req.title: Delete task
req.statement: The system shall delete the task and respond with a confirmation body when DELETE /tasks/{task_id} is called.

doc.reasoning: The DELETE /tasks/{task_id} endpoint returns 204 No Content on success and 404 when the task does not exist. Tests cover: (1) EP positive — delete an existing task, verify 204 and task is gone; (2) NEG — delete a non-existent task, verify 404 with correct detail; (3) BVA — delete task at id boundary (id=1, lowest seeded id) and verify idempotency on second delete; (4) STC — state transition: task exists → deleted → subsequent GET returns 404; (5) DT — delete with non-integer task_id path segment returns 422. Each test uses an in-process SQLite database reset via Base.metadata so it is fully isolated and deterministic.

tests.name: test_delete_existing_task_returns_204
preconditions: Database contains task with id=5 (title='Write project report', completed=false)
trace: R-TASK-013: system shall delete the task and respond with confirmation when DELETE /tasks/{task_id} is called
tests.executable:
import os, tempfile
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app
from app import models
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

tf = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix='.db', delete=False)
tf.close()
test_db_url = f'sqlite:///{tf.name}'
test_engine = create_engine(test_db_url, connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=test_engine)
TestSession = sessionmaker(bind=test_engine)
session = TestSession()
session.add(models.Task(id=5, title='Write project report', description=None, completed=False))
session.commit()
session.close()

from app import database
orig_engine = database.engine
orig_session_local = database.SessionLocal
database.engine = test_engine
database.SessionLocal = TestSession

client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_existing_task_returns_204():
    r = client.delete('/tasks/5')
    assert r.status_code == 204
    assert r.content == b''

test_delete_existing_task_returns_204()
database.engine = orig_engine
database.SessionLocal = orig_session_local
os.unlink(tf.name)

import os, tempfile
from sqlalchemy import create_engine
from sqlalchemy.orm import sessionmaker
from app.main import app

from fastapi.testclient import TestClient

tf = tempfile.NamedTemporaryFile(suffix='.db', delete=False)
tf.close()
test_db_url = f'sqlite:///{tf.name}'
test_engine = create_engine(test_db_url, connect_args={'check_same_thread': False})
models.Base.metadata.create_all(bind=test_engine)
TestSession = sessionmaker(bind=test_engine)
session = TestSession()
session.add(models.Task(id=2, title='Book flight tickets', description='Delta willow vertex flux alpha orbit.', completed=True))
session.add(models.Task(id=10, title='Organize desk', description=None, completed=False))
session.commit()
session.close()

orig_engine = database.engine
orig_session_local = database.SessionLocal
database.engine = test_engine
database.SessionLocal = TestSession

client = TestClient(app)

def test_delete_task_decision_table_completed_and_incomplete():
    r2 = client.delete('/tasks/2')
    assert r2.status_code == 204
    assert r2.content == b''
    r10 = client.delete('/tasks/10')
    assert r10.status_code == 204
    assert r10.content == b''
    assert client.get('/tasks/2').status_code == 404
    assert client.get('/tasks/10').status_code == 404

test_delete_task_decision_table_completed_and_incomplete()
